skins.title: Brand Skin & Persona
skins.paragraph: Switch between high-converting consumable brand personas. All typography, button colors, and token palettes adapt automatically.
skins.label: Theme Skin

paragraphs.cart_gamification: Set Tier 1 (Free Shipping) 15–20% higher than your baseline AOV to encourage multi-pack upgrades. Set Tier 2 (Free Gift) at 1.5x–2x AOV to drive checkout completion.
paragraphs.pack_economics: Consumables brands convert up to 23% higher when offering 3 distinct pack sizes. A 10–15% discount on Tier 2 creates a powerful cognitive anchor that shifts volume away from single-unit orders to maximize Average Order Value (AOV).
paragraphs.subscription: Top-converting brands avoid deceptive stealth subscriptions. Clear dual-card toggles paired with explicit 'Skip or cancel anytime' assurances eliminate customer checkout hesitation.
paragraphs.guardrail_telemetry: Ensure custom.roast_level and custom.origin_telemetry are populated in your Shopify Product Admin. If left blank, this block will automatically collapse cleanly with zero layout shift or whitespace gaps.

infos.tier_2_badge: Highlighting Tier 2 as 'Most Popular' leverages social proof to steer default selection.
infos.show_per_serving_price: Requires custom.unit_servings metafield. Breaking high bundle prices into '$1.13 / cup' eliminates price shock.
infos.sub_discount_badge: The sweet spot for consumable subscription discounts is 15% to 20%.
